call.compose: Resolve call IDs through call.map, OR selected parts by frame or strip_indices, then apply selected color and global brightness.

encoding.frame: 94 hex chars; 47 bytes packed LSB-first (LED i in byte i>>3, mask 1<<(i&7)); the theoretical minimum 370-LED frame
encoding.row_hex: local bitmap rows; bit7 is local x=0; use only size[0] bits
encoding.strip_indices: physical serpentine LED indices mapped back to logical packed-frame cells when used as fallback
